title: Schema for the map layouts data file: the tile sides each map is built from

map_id.description: Foreign key to the map in data/maps.json.

tile_id.description: Foreign key to the tile in data/map-tiles.json.

side.description: The side of the tile the map uses.

count.description: How many times the map places this side. A map built from sections that replace each other during its mission can place a side more often than a box has copies.
